newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kolbenschmidt ends French piston venture.
newsitem.headline: Kolbenschmidt ends French piston venture.

text.p: German auto parts maker Kolbenschmidt AG said on Thursday it was ending its partnership in France with piston and engine block maker Mahle GmbH of Stuttgart.
Mahle would take over Kolbenschmidt's 50 percent share of Pistons de Colmar S.a.r.l., which had 1996/97 sales of 460 million francs and employed 600 workers.
The separation would allow each company to expand its market share in France, the companies said in a statement. Mahle would take over the Colmar production site on October 1.
Kolbenschmidt has another piston partnership in France with Societe Mosellane de Pistons in Thionville.
Defence and engineering group Rheinmetall AG last month took a majority stake in Kolbenschmidt, and planned to merge the group with its own automotive unit, Pierburg AG.
